_meta.scope: Open-weight LLM/VLM options for Forge. Prices USD per 1M text tokens; image-token pricing not included. 'native' = host lists structured_outputs (json_schema) for that endpoint.
_meta.guardrailFit: Photos: only on-device runtimes, DeepInfra direct (non-Google models; Gemma via DeepInfra direct is ambiguous under DeepInfra's 'Google models' clause), Groq/Fireworks/Together with ZDR, or OpenRouter with ZDR enforced satisfy the no-train rule. JSON: pick 'native' hosts and keep Forge's tolerant extraction. Safe language (safety_messaging_no_praise_for_restriction, safety_messaging_no_body_shaming, safety_crisis_disclosure, photo_no_attractiveness_commentary) must stay enforced by Forge's blocklist + regenerate filter for every model; no model here has published eating-disorder safe-messaging evals (UNVERIFIED for all). Fireworks/Together direct-API ZDR terms were not re-verified on 2026-11-21.
_meta.accuracyEvidence: OmniFood-Bench (arXiv 2607.08423) reports catastrophic mass-estimation failure across 6 VLMs incl. qwen3-vl-8B, gpt-5.1, gemini-3-flash. No per-model Nutrition5k calorie MAE found for open-weight models. Forge's deterministic clamps and high bias remain required.
_meta.openRouterPrivacyHowTo: Add "provider": {"zdr": true, "require_parameters": true} to the request body, or enable ZDR in OpenRouter account privacy settings (account setting is OR-combined with the per-request flag). Forge currently sends a plain OpenAI body, so use the account setting unless the provider object is added.
_meta.notCovered: Kimi-VL, MiMo-VL (7B), DeepSeek-VL/VL2 and Qwen3.5 small (2B/4B) VL were not found on the reachable hosts and were not benchmarked on-device; omitted rather than guessed.

models.priceSource: OpenRouter endpoints/ZDR API 2026-11-21: NextBit (bf16) $0.0675/$0.225 with structured_outputs. DeepInfra direct id google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it $0.07/$0.34 (DeepInfra models API).
models.notes: MoE 25.2B total / ~3.8B active (OpenRouter description). Cheapest credible vision model for FOOD_PHOTO/LABEL. Also reachable as openai-compatible: https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai with model google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (DeepInfra: inputs not stored on disk, not logged, not used for training; json_schema supported). Avoid the ':free' variant (no structured_outputs; free-tier policy). Data policy 'no-train' holds only when OpenRouter is forced to ZDR endpoints (provider.zdr=true per request, or ZDR / 'deny training providers' in account privacy settings); the price quoted is the cheapest endpoint in OpenRouter's ZDR list (/api/v1/endpoints/zdr, 2026-11-21) that also lists structured_outputs. Without ZDR, routing may hit non-ZDR hosts (Novita, Chutes, Baidu, Alibaba, Z.AI, Moonshot, Xiaomi were absent from the ZDR list). Food-calorie accuracy UNVERIFIED. CAVEAT (verification 2026-11-21): DeepInfra's data-privacy page carves out 'Google models' (Google stores outputs, logs prompts for abuse detection, Google training policy applies). DeepInfra also resells Gemini, so the clause most likely targets Gemini, but it does not say whether self-hosted google/gemma-* ids are exempt - treat DeepInfra-direct Gemma as UNVERIFIED for the photo no-train rule and prefer the OpenRouter ZDR route.
